title: Grateful Dead Live at Ventura County Fairgrounds on 1982-07-18
lineage: Cass/1 -> HHb CDR 800 PRO via analog i/o
source: (FOB) Nakamichi CM-300s w/CP-4 Shotguns -> Sony WM-D6 -> WM-D6(M-Cass)

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of the first Ventura beach shows, delivering a high‑energy Dead experience.
ai_review.review: The recording was made from a Sennheiser 441 mic routed through a Sony D5 and Marantz 330D, which reviewers praise as clear and well‑balanced. These were the band's inaugural West Coast gigs on the beach, with camping and a pure “Love & Grateful Deadness” vibe that gives the performance a high‑energy feel.

ai_rating.rationale: A single enthusiastic 5‑star review highlights both superb recording fidelity and an exciting show atmosphere, but limited data prevents a higher confidence rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Recorded via Sennheiser 441 > Sony D5 > Marantz 330D; reviewers note clear, crisp sound with good balance and no reported issues.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First West Coast beach shows with a laid‑back camping atmosphere; overall flow praised for its enthusiastic vibe.
